glosses: among these, including (indicates membership in a mentioned set)

examples.text: Kannst du dir was darunter vorstellen?
examples.en: Does that suggest something to you?

examples.text: Es kommt darauf an, was du darunter verstehst.
examples.en: It depends on what you mean by that.

examples.text: Ich spreche drei Sprachen, darunter Französisch.
examples.en: I speak three languages, including French.

examples.text: Tom spricht viele Sprachen, darunter auch Französisch.
examples.en: Tom speaks many languages, including French.
